Strategy presentation

Before the tests, watch a short live demonstration of how our operators work.

At Sigma Dynamix, operators do not decide when to trade. The desk marks key price levels: when the price reaches one of them, an authorization signal lights up. Your job is to choose the direction, buy or sell, and to manage the trade.

Taking every signal is mandatory. Your evaluation compares you with other operators on the same signals, so a skipped signal cannot be scored and counts against you.

One trade per authorization, 10 MNQ. You have 3 minutes to enter with Buy or Sell.

An authorization is not an order to enter immediately: it tells you the price is in a zone where you may trade. You can wait a minute or two for a better price before opening your position.

A stop loss is placed automatically from your entry. You can bring it closer at any time, never move it further.

You add your own take profits: choose a quantity, click +TP (placed by default at twice the stop distance), then drag the line where you want. You can split the position over several take profits, and close only part of it: choose a quantity and click Close.

The demo replays a real NQ market moment and shows two examples: one buy, one sell. Watching it in full is required before the tests.

Did you understand everything?

You can rewatch the demo if anything is unclear — otherwise, continue to the trading tests.
